matt.title: Matt Pocock skills (vendored at vendor/matt, see .sync/upstreams.json)
matt.note: Heavier workflow suite; load on demand. matt-flow is the fork's flow map. Buckets: engineering, productivity are promoted; misc, in-progress, deprecated are not.

pstack.title: pstack (cursor/plugins, vendored whole at vendor/pstack)
pstack.note: Vendored as one whole plugin (subagents, sibling paths, automations). On Cursor prefer the native plugin; elsewhere the indexed texts read with degraded features.

impeccable.title: Impeccable (pbakaus/impeccable, vendored at vendor/impeccable)
impeccable.note: Apache-2.0, verbatim upstream incl. NOTICE.md; the adapted copy installed by ui-kit lives at skills/impeccable (see vendor/impeccable/MODIFICATIONS.md).

addy.title: Addy Osmani agent-skills (vendored subset at vendor/addy)
addy.note: Only api-and-interface-design is vendored; the adapted copy in skills/ inlines its external references and drops cross-skill links.

system-design.title: proyecto26 system-design-skills (vendored at vendor/system-design)
system-design.note: Source material for the rewritten skills/system-design; the vendored copy keeps the full plugin for reference.

bmad.title: BMAD-METHOD (vendored subset at vendor/bmad)
bmad.note: Only bmad-ux is vendored, as the template source for skills/ux-spec; the BMAD framework itself is not installed.
